action.command: cd /workspace && export USER_ID=1000 GROUP_ID=1000 && docker compose up -d web_application >/tmp/up_web.log 2>&1; grep -v level=warning /tmp/up_web.log | tail -5; sleep 10; curl -sL -o /dev/null -w "web docker 3003 login: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 20 http://localhost:3003/; docker compose logs web_application --tail=8 2>&1 | grep -v level=warning | tail -8
